<documents>
<document id="products-credit">
CreditˆcardsˆandˆloansˆTallowbrookˆdoesn'tˆofferˆcreditˆcards,ˆpersonalˆloans,ˆmortgages,ˆautoˆloansˆorˆlinesˆofˆcredit.ˆ##ˆYourˆTallowbrookˆcardˆisˆaˆdebitˆcardˆItˆspendsˆmoneyˆthat'sˆalreadyˆinˆyourˆaccount.ˆItˆdoesn'tˆbuildˆcreditˆhistoryˆandˆdoesn'tˆappearˆonˆyourˆcreditˆreport.ˆ##ˆIsˆCushionˆaˆloan?ˆCushionˆcoversˆsmallˆdebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆonˆPlusˆandˆPremiumˆwithˆnoˆfeesˆorˆinterest.ˆItˆisn'tˆaˆlineˆofˆcredit,ˆisn'tˆreportedˆtoˆcreditˆbureaus,ˆandˆisˆrepaidˆautomaticallyˆfromˆyourˆnextˆdeposit.ˆ##ˆCreditˆchecksˆWeˆdon'tˆrunˆaˆhardˆcreditˆcheckˆwhenˆyouˆopenˆanˆaccount.ˆ##ˆPayingˆaˆloanˆorˆcardˆfromˆanotherˆlenderˆYouˆcanˆpayˆotherˆlendersˆfromˆyourˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆbyˆACH,ˆusingˆyourˆroutingˆandˆaccountˆnumber.ˆ##ˆLookingˆforˆcredit?ˆWeˆcan'tˆrecommendˆlendersˆorˆgiveˆadviceˆaboutˆborrowing.ˆ##ˆCreditˆreportsˆBecauseˆweˆdon'tˆlend,ˆweˆdon'tˆreportˆyourˆaccountˆtoˆcreditˆbureaus.ˆAˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆwon'tˆraiseˆorˆlowerˆyourˆcreditˆscore.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="transfers-cancel">
CancellingˆaˆtransferˆWhetherˆyouˆcanˆcancelˆaˆtransferˆdependsˆonˆtheˆtypeˆofˆtransferˆandˆhowˆfarˆalongˆitˆis.ˆ##ˆScheduledˆorˆpendingˆACHˆtransfersˆYouˆcanˆcancelˆaˆscheduledˆACHˆtransferˆinˆtheˆappˆuntilˆtheˆACHˆcutoffˆtimeˆ(4:00ˆPMˆET)ˆonˆitsˆsendˆdate.ˆTapˆTransfers,ˆchooseˆtheˆtransferˆandˆtapˆCancel.ˆAfterˆtheˆcutoff,ˆtheˆtransferˆisˆalreadyˆonˆitsˆwayˆandˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelled.ˆ##ˆBrookPayˆBrookPayˆpaymentsˆarriveˆinstantlyˆandˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelled.ˆ##ˆWiresˆWiresˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelledˆonceˆsent.ˆWeˆcanˆaskˆtheˆreceivingˆbankˆtoˆreturnˆtheˆmoney,ˆbutˆtheˆreceivingˆbankˆdecides,ˆandˆitˆisn'tˆguaranteed.ˆ##ˆRecurringˆtransfersˆYouˆcanˆstopˆfutureˆtransfersˆinˆaˆrecurringˆseriesˆatˆanyˆtime.ˆStoppingˆtheˆseriesˆdoesn'tˆcancelˆaˆtransferˆthat'sˆalreadyˆpastˆitsˆcutoff.ˆ##ˆSentˆtoˆtheˆwrongˆaccount?ˆIfˆanˆACHˆtransferˆwentˆtoˆtheˆwrongˆexternalˆaccount,ˆmessageˆsupport.ˆWe'llˆtryˆtoˆcontactˆtheˆotherˆbank,ˆbutˆweˆcan'tˆpromiseˆtheˆmoneyˆcomesˆback.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="disputes-pending">
Whyˆcan'tˆIˆdisputeˆaˆpendingˆtransaction?ˆYouˆcan'tˆdisputeˆaˆtransactionˆwhileˆit'sˆstillˆpending.ˆAˆpendingˆtransactionˆisˆanˆauthorization.ˆTheˆmerchantˆhasn'tˆcollectedˆtheˆmoneyˆyet,ˆandˆtheˆamountˆcanˆstillˆchangeˆorˆdisappear.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆWaitˆforˆtheˆtransactionˆtoˆpost.ˆMostˆpendingˆtransactionsˆpostˆorˆdropˆoffˆwithinˆ7ˆdays.ˆOnceˆitˆposts,ˆtheˆDisputeˆoptionˆappearsˆwhenˆyouˆtapˆit.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆrecognizeˆitˆFreezeˆyourˆcardˆnow,ˆevenˆthoughˆyouˆcan'tˆdisputeˆyet.ˆThatˆstopsˆanyˆmoreˆcharges.ˆWhenˆtheˆtransactionˆposts,ˆdisputeˆitˆasˆunauthorized.ˆYourˆdisputeˆwindowˆstartsˆfromˆtheˆstatementˆitˆpostsˆon,ˆsoˆyouˆwon'tˆloseˆtimeˆbyˆwaiting.ˆ##ˆIfˆtheˆamountˆisˆwrongˆPendingˆamountsˆareˆoftenˆestimates,ˆforˆexampleˆatˆgasˆpumpsˆorˆhotels.ˆTheˆpostedˆamountˆisˆusuallyˆdifferent.ˆWaitˆandˆseeˆwhatˆposts.ˆ##ˆIfˆit'sˆbeenˆpendingˆaˆlongˆtimeˆSomeˆmerchantsˆtakeˆlonger.ˆIfˆaˆtransactionˆhasˆbeenˆpendingˆmuchˆlongerˆthanˆusual,ˆmessageˆsupportˆandˆwe'llˆlookˆatˆit.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
